feature_manifest_version.note: The frozen model artifact's own metadata (models/model_metadata_v1.json) records the manifest tag active at training time as 'phase4-v1', which predates the current code constant's '1.0.0' string. The underlying 68-feature manifest itself has not changed since training (verified by Phase 17 audit 5); this is a version-label naming inconsistency, not a feature-set drift, and is recorded here rather than silently reconciled.

ui_version.note: Bumped from the Vite scaffold default (0.0.0) to track this release at Phase 18 packaging; no UI code changed.

xgboost_model_version.note: models/model_metadata_v1.json records model_version 'v1.1'; the artifact filenames use the '_v1' suffix (the filename identifies the artifact slot/manifest generation, the metadata's model_version field identifies the specific trained instance). Both are recorded here to avoid ambiguity. This model artifact is FROZEN for this release -- see 'Final architecture freeze' in README.md.

known_limitations_preserved_from_phase_1: No DB-level uniqueness constraint on circadian_labels.is_latest (enforced by application discipline only).

Structured version-provenance columns are incomplete: only the XGBoost model version is a queryable column (via TrainingRun); pipeline/fusion/state/alignment/recommendation config versions exist only inside AlignmentResult.component_snapshot's JSON blob, and ContributorResult/InterventionLog carry no version information at all.

app.personalization.db_adapter.latest_recommendation_id_for_type is not as_of_date-scoped (a catalogue-versioning gap, not a participant-data leak -- participant behavioral/outcome data is correctly as_of_date-scoped throughout).
scientific_scope_reminder: All model metrics and simulated trajectories in this release were produced on SYNTHETIC data. No component has been validated against real human circadian/DLMO measurements. See docs/scientific_assumptions.md and docs/research_handoff.md.
